violations.text: Laminate lining at counter fixtures were observed in poor repair (exposing composite wood). Equipment to be in good repair and proper adjustment. New Violation. Correct By: 12/02/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of black residue. New Violation. Correct By: 09/09/2026

The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was 0 parts per million (ppm). Air gap was observed in sanitizer line. Dispenser to be properly adjusted. Sanitizer must be manually mixed until dispenser is properly adjusted. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2025

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Rhode Island Certified Food Protection Manager license expired. FMC must be re-instated after food safety manager certificate obtained. Application provided during time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 06/23/2024
1. Laminate line wood panel by handwashing sink observed in poor repair. 2. Faucet at 3 bay sink observed leaking. New Violation. Correct By: 06/06/2024
